jsonld.headline: What if we’re already too late?
jsonld.text: Why Nigeria Needs AI Policy For Its Universities — Before It’s Too Late
jsonld.articleBody:
What if we’re already too late?

While the world is busy building the next generation of AI talent, Nigeria is stuck asking the wrong questions: Should we be teaching AI? Instead, we should be asking: How do we lead?

My article, “Why Nigeria Needs an AI Policy for Its Universities — Before It’s Too Late,” has now been published in The Independent Newspapers Nigeria because I believe we’re standing at a turning point. The absence of a national AI policy in our universities isn’t just an oversight — it’s a threat to our future.

Young Nigerians are brilliant. But brilliance without infrastructure, guidance, and vision gets exported or extinguished. We’re watching other nations train innovators while we risk becoming permanent consumers in a world we should help build.

I outline a path forward — one that involves bold leadership from the Ministry of Education, the National Universities Commission, and Nigeria’s tech ecosystem.

AI isn’t just a technological shift. It’s a strategic one.

Read the full article here: https://lnkd.in/eM7b5MPG

Let’s stop playing catch-up.
Let’s start leading.

#AI #Nigeria #HigherEducation #NationalPolicy #Innovation #FutureReady
